// diagnostic E1404

Jet.DevtoolsPublicationUnlabeled

This published value has no gate

What

This published value has no gate

Why

A published value must name itself with both `field:` and `value:` labels

Fix

Write `devtools.publish(field: .<state_field>, value: <expr>)`

Worked example
